notes.title: Update released
notes.content:
New update of DeathMetal has just been released with several bugfixes. The bug with entering level 5 in episodes (after you unlocked following episode and wanted to replay the previous one) should be fixed by now. We have also fixed framerate/controlling issue for "Fast" graphic settings.

For next update we are thinking about adding several more achievements, as the current ones are quite easily achievable (maybe with the exception of 6 balls at once :)). What you achievement hunters think about it?

Let us know your thoughts and enjoy. :)
